perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Steady Hands
enhanced.description: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a longer duration.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: Stats for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for an improved duration.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Tracking Module
perks.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Tracking Module
enhanced.description: Adds tracking capability to rockets. Locks onto targets when aiming down sights. Increases blast radius.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

enhanced.name: Chill Clip
enhanced.description: Direct hits with the majority of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Unrelenting
perks.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one kill.

enhanced.name: Unrelenting
enhanced.description: Rapidly defeating targets triggers improved health regeneration. Guardians and powerful combatants count as more than one target.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

enhanced.name: Turnabout
enhanced.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

flavor: "If you hear a noise in the dark, shoot first." —Centurion Tuk'rin
